The '''Platoon Attack Craft (PAC)''', also known as the '''Trade Federation troop carrier''' or '''battle droid troop carrier''', was a [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsled]] personnel [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to transport [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TFtroopcarrier_ep1ig.png|thumb|left|180px|Troop [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] schematics.]]
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] developed its Platoon Attack Craft after the success of the deployment racks installed within their [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]]. The Federation retrofitted a series of commercial [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorlift sleds]] with the same design and technology, and re-designated the vessels as Platoon Attack Crafts, for use as [[Troop carrier/Legends|troop carriers]].<ref name="FF16" /> The craft's drive unit was similarly adapted from a civilian [[cargo sled]].<ref name="CCS" />

An unarmed variant of the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]], the troop carrier boasted no weaponry or heavy armor and had to rely on AATs and battle droids for protection. It was deployed behind the protection of ground armor in secure conditions, or within occupied territory. The troop carrier was also equipped with a forward flood light for use at night. Although the MTT offered greater protection, the troop carrier was faster and more agile, and many were still retained in the Trade Federation's forces.

The troop carrier was piloted by two battle droid pilots. Similar to the deployment racks used in MTTs, the troop carrier's single rack could hold one hundred and twelve battle droids, folded into their space-saving configurations. Together, these droid passengers formed a single company of troops that consisted of two platoons.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==History==
[[File:PACs.png|thumb|180px|Troop carriers head towards the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] alongside [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTTs]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]].]] Up to 28 troop carriers could be fitted onto one C-9979 landing ship.

During the events of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the troop carriers were brought to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] along with MTTs and AATs in [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]. The troop carriers were part of the Trade Federation invasion force that occupied the capital city [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], troop carriers were pledged by the Trade Federation to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], they transported battle droid platoons from the planet's underground [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factories]] for deployment in the Separatist forces. Troop carriers brought battle droids into the [[Petranaki arena]] when [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team arrived to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].

Troop carriers were later used in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. After the Clone Wars ended, the few troop carriers that survived the conflict were converted into civilian cargo sleds.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kash_PAC.png|thumb|left|180px|A troop [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]].]]
Originally created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref> the Platoon Attack Craft was first identified in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 16|sixteenth issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'',<ref name="FF16" /> a name that originated in the revised rough draft of ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>
